description: Date-awareness cases (prompt v3): old-dated documentation must suppress; newly published aggregate stats must surface. Modeled on a live misclassification 2026-09-12 (LAUREN II / June 20 imagery surfaced as an event).

posts.text: M/T LAUREN II loading crude at Kharg Island's Azarpad jetty, June 20, 2026. One of the last laden departures we imaged before the strikes began.
Saudi Arabia's August crude exports hit a 20-year low of 3.4 mbpd per tanker-tracking data, down 41% m/m, as eastern terminals absorb the Petroline outage and Red Sea loadings stay shut.
